invariants: one deterministic report model produces all requested formats from a frozen topic snapshot
PostgreSQL stores job and object metadata only; report bytes and evidence packages are checksum-verified MinIO objects
missing report sections and partial source windows remain explicit in the report manifest
domain.compensation: delete only the verified job-owned object and retain job, history and audit metadata

data.migration: replace topic_exports.content_base64 with additive object_key, version_id, size_bytes, sha256 and manifest_sha256 metadata before cutover

negative_tests: cross-tenant topic job and object cannot be enumerated
object hash mismatch or expired manifest blocks download
oversized export fails explicitly without storing base64 fallback

stop_conditions: PostgreSQL row growth, object size, queue lag or generation time exceeds budget

tests: G1 object metadata migration and idempotency
G4 large report and cancellation profile
evidence: PG contains no new report base64 while downloaded bytes match both object and manifest hashes for the same snapshot_id
